[task: gen2-daily-probe v1]
You are an experienced teacher of Mandarin Chinese writing practice sentences for an adult beginner (Mukyu). Sentences are 2–4 Mandarin words, never more than 6.
TARGET WORD: 可以 — "can / may / okay" (asking or giving permission) · word class: verb
This is a VERB. Every sentence must contain THIS verb itself in some form (dictionary, polite, past, negative, て-form, volitional …); a sentence that only implies it does not count.
SPEAKERS: Two adult friends speaking everyday Mandarin (simplified characters, no pinyin in the sentence).
ALLOWED WORDS — use ONLY these words, the target word, and normal grammar (particles, inflection): 为什么 可以 一点 一起 什么 这个 那个 喜欢 没有 哪里 这里 那里 现在 今天 明天 昨天 怎么 多少 东西 地方 朋友 工作 真的 觉得 知道 你好 再见 不错 一下 到 多 少 快 慢 大 小 很 太 跟 回 拿 用 做 等 找 我 想 吃 你 好 喝 要 不 有 去 来 在 谁 钱 买 人 家 懂 说 听 看 给 帮 开 吗 个 的 呢 吧 了 没 过 着 比 嗯
Write 6 candidate practice sentences. Together they must show at least THREE DIFFERENT real uses of the target: different everyday situations and different things said or asked (e.g. asking, answering, offering, refusing, suggesting, describing) — never the same sentence with one word changed.
VOCABULARY DISCIPLINE: every noun, verb, adjective and adverb must come from ALLOWED WORDS (or be the target). Do not use any other word, however common — no other nouns (no animals, foods, places or objects that are not listed), no people's names. If an idea needs an unlisted word, choose a different idea.
SIMPLE BEATS CLEVER: with few words available, write short, very common sentences a native speaker really says every day (e.g. 人很多。 / 我到了。 / 这个多少钱？). Never build an unusual sentence just to fit the word list.
Every sentence must be complete, grammatically perfect, and something a native speaker would naturally say to a friend in an everyday situation, using the target in the sense "can / may / okay". Do not invent odd combinations just to use the allowed words.
For each candidate give: "function" (1–3 words), "situation" (when it is said, short English), "cue" (an English instruction telling the learner WHAT TO COMMUNICATE without giving the words, e.g. "Ask your friend whether they are free tonight." — never a translation of the sentence; a learner following it should naturally need THIS target word), "text" (the Mandarin Chinese sentence: ONE utterance by ONE speaker — never a question together with its answer; normal writing with no spaces between words), "english" (a faithful natural translation that keeps the nuance), "speaker" ("male", "female" or "either").
If this word cannot be used naturally with the allowed words, return "teachable": false with a short "reason" instead of forcing sentences.
Return ONLY JSON: {"teachable": true, "reason": "", "candidates": [{"function": "", "situation": "", "cue": "", "text": "", "english": "", "speaker": ""}]}
